R='/project1/glsl_test_5'
import json
results={}
for c in op(R).children:
    if c.type==td.textDAT and 'info' in c.name.lower():
        results['info_text']=str(c.text)[:500]
        results['info_name']=c.name
    if c.type==td.glslPOP:
        results['errors']=str(c.errors())
        results['outputattrs']=c.par.outputattrs.eval()
        results['numelems']=c.par.numelems.eval()
        results['num_inputs']=len(c.inputConnectors)
        results['computedat']=c.par.computedat.eval()
# Also list all children
results['children']=[{'name':c.name,'type':str(c.type)} for c in op(R).children]
print(json.dumps(results))
